item.title: India jails ‘cockroach’ leaders over protests against alleged voter roll manipulation
item.description: Two leaders of India’s youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) were remanded in custody for five days on Wednesday, as police ratcheted up efforts to clamp down on anti-election commission protests. CJP activists and opposition parties have defied a security crackdown to demand the resignation of India’s chief election commissioner, accusing the poll body of manipulating voter rolls to benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s ruling party. The commission, which oversees voting in the world’s most... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Joni Mitchell becomes US citizen: ‘A journey that began 62 years ago’
item.description: Canada-born singer-songwriter, 82, posts footage of citizenship ceremony to Instagram Joni Mitchell has become a US citizen, after first moving to the country in the mid-1960s. The Canada-born singer-songwriter, 82, posted footage of her citizenship ceremony on her Instagram account, along with a photo of her next to an American flag, accompanied by the caption: “A journey that began 62 years ago.” It means that Mitchell can now vote in US elections, something that she had complained she wasn’t able to do. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Malaysia’s Najib loses bid to suspend 15-year 1MDB sentence on medical grounds
item.description: A Malaysian court on Wednesday rejected Najib Razak’s bid to suspend his 15-year jail sentence in the 1MDB scandal pending the jailed former prime minister’s appeals, ruling that his health and other grounds did not justify a stay. The decision means his sentence is set to begin after his current prison term ends in August 2028. Najib, 73, received a conditional royal pardon last month allowing him to serve that separate sentence in the SRC International case at home, but he must first pay a 50... item.title: 13 children die after overloaded boat capsizes in India
item.description: Rescuers dragged 13 dead children out of India’s Ganges River after an overloaded boat capsized en route to a Hindu festival, officials said on Wednesday, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressing grief over the “deeply painful” tragedy. The boat overturned late on Tuesday in Vaishali district in eastern Bihar state, with locals rushing to pull people out of the water in the dark using mobile phones to find the bodies. “It was dark when we suddenly heard children screaming and crying for help... item.description: España celebrará elecciones generales anticipadas el próximo 29 de noviembre para renovar el Congreso de los Diputados y el Senado. En este país, los ciudadanos no eligen directamente al presidente del Gobierno: votan a sus representantes parlamentarios, y son los diputados del Congreso quienes deciden mediante una votación quién puede encabezar el Ejecutivo. Para entender los resultados electorales, también es importante conocer el método D’Hondt, la fórmula que se utiliza para repartir los escaños del Congreso entre las candidaturas en cada circunscripción.
